   117→- Use `ref.watch()` for reactive state watching
   118→- Use `ref.read()` for one-time reads in callbacks
   119→- Convert to `ConsumerStatefulWidget` when local state is needed (e.g., cursor position)

   121→### Keyboard Event Handling Pattern (Flutter Standard)
   122→
   123→```dart
   124→Focus(
   125→  autofocus: true,
   126→  onKeyEvent: (node, event) {
   127→    if (event is KeyDownEvent) {
   128→      final isShiftPressed = HardwareKeyboard.instance.isShiftPressed;
   129→
   130→      if (event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.space) {
   131→        if (isShiftPressed) {
   132→          // Shift+Space: deselect and move back
   133→        } else {
   134→          // Space: select and advance
   135→        }
   136→        return KeyEventResult.handled;
   137→      }
   138→      if (event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter) {
   139→        if (isShiftPressed) {
   140→          // Shift+Enter: undo group
   141→        } else {
   142→          // Enter: create group
   143→        }
   144→        return KeyEventResult.handled;
   145→      }
   146→    }
   147→    return KeyEventResult.ignored;
   148→  },
   149→  child: // ... screen content
   150→)
   151→```

   153→**Key Points:**
   154→- Wrap screen content with `Focus` widget
   155→- Set `autofocus: true` to capture keyboard immediately
   156→- Check `HardwareKeyboard.instance.isShiftPressed` for modifier keys
   157→- Return `KeyEventResult.handled` to prevent event bubbling
   158→
   159→## Requirements
   160→
   161→### Functional Requirements
   162→
   163→1. **Export Destination Prompt**
   164→   - Description: When user enters the GroupingScreen, show a directory picker dialog to select the export destination
   165→   - Acceptance: Dialog appears on screen entry; selected directory is stored and used during final export
   166→
   167→2. **Space Key Selection**
   168→   - Description: Pressing Space selects the currently focused photo and automatically moves the cursor to the next photo
   169→   - Acceptance: Photo at cursor position becomes selected; cursor advances to next ungrouped photo
   170→
   171→3. **Shift+Space Deselection**
   172→   - Description: Pressing Shift+Space deselects the currently focused photo and moves the cursor backward to the previous photo
   173→   - Acceptance: Photo at cursor position becomes deselected; cursor moves to previous ungrouped photo
   174→
   175→4. **Enter Group Creation**
   176→   - Description: Pressing Enter creates a group from all currently selected photos
   177→   - Acceptance: New group appears in sidebar; selected photos move from ungrouped grid to the group
   178→
   179→5. **Shift+Enter Undo**
   180→   - Description: Pressing Shift+Enter undoes the last group creation, returning photos to ungrouped state
   181→   - Acceptance: Last created group is removed; its photos return to the ungrouped grid with cursor on first returned photo
   182→
   183→6. **Visual Cursor Indicator**
   184→   - Description: The currently focused photo should have a distinct visual indicator (e.g., colored border, highlight)
   185→   - Acceptance: User can always see which photo will be affected by keyboard actions
   186→
   187→### Edge Cases
   188→
   189→1. **Cursor at end of list (Space)** - Wrap to beginning or stop at last photo
   190→2. **Cursor at start of list (Shift+Space)** - Stop at first photo or wrap to end
   191→3. **No photos selected (Enter)** - Show message or do nothing gracefully
   192→4. **No groups to undo (Shift+Enter)** - Do nothing gracefully
   193→5. **All photos grouped** - Disable keyboard navigation, show completion message
   194→6. **User cancels directory picker** - Allow continuing without directory (will prompt again at export)
   195→7. **Web platform** - Skip directory picker (web uses browser download)

   202→- Use `ref.watch(ungroupedImagesProvider)` to get the list for navigation

   204→- Store last created group ID in `GroupsNotifier` for undo functionality
   205→- Show visual feedback immediately on key press (before async operations)
   206→- Use existing `ExportService.getExportDirectory()` for the directory picker
   207→

   211→- Don't block UI during directory selection (show dialog, handle result async)

   213→- Don't forget to handle the case where `ungroupedImages` becomes empty
